## 简体中文

### 修复

- 拖动时实时重排任务栏应用图标，通过 Fluent 风格避让动画替代整条任务栏刷新。
- 淡化被拖动图标的背景并缩小运行指示器，同时让图标持续跟随指针。
- 当被拖动图标中心越过目标图标中心时触发避让，不受抓取图标位置影响。
- 将任务栏图标拖动限制在任务栏轴线上，避免图标被拖离任务栏。

## English

### Fixed

- Reordered taskbar app icons live while dragging, with Fluent-style animated avoidance instead of a full taskbar refresh.
- Faded the dragged icon background and shrank its running indicator while keeping the icon attached to the pointer.
- Triggered avoidance when the dragged icon center crossed the target icon center, independent of where the icon was grabbed.
- Locked taskbar icon dragging to the taskbar axis so icons cannot be pulled away from the bar.
